routes.label: Follow the three levels of the tree

question: Toss 3 fair coins in succession. Draw a tree diagram in your working, then enter the total number of equally likely outcomes.
solution: Let H mean heads and T mean tails. The tree has two branches at each stage: first H or T; from H, the second-stage branches are HH and HT, and from T they are TH and TT. At the third stage the branches are \[\begin{array}{c|cc}HH&HHH&HHT\\HT&HTH&HTT\\TH&THH&THT\\TT&TTH&TTT\end{array}\] The eight leaves are equally likely because the coins are fair and the tosses are independent. Thus \(2\times2\times2=8\) outcomes are possible. Enter 8; keep the tree in your working.
